```{r}
# ==============================================================================
# METABRIC Agilent microarray analysis
#
# Comparison : Grade 1 + Grade 2 vs Grade 3
# Contrast   : Grade3 - Grade1_2
# DEG        : BH FDR < 0.05 AND |logFC| >= 1
# Direction  : positive logFC / t / NES = higher in Grade 3
#              negative logFC / t / NES = higher in Grade 1/2
#
# Analyses
#   1. limma differential expression
#   2. PCA, volcano plot, heatmap
#   3. GSEA (all genes ranked by limma t) for
#        Hallmark, Reactome, GO_BP, GO_MF, GO_CC
#        - Main plot  : FDR < 0.05 + redundancy filter (Jaccard < 0.5 kept)
#        - Backup plot: FDR < 0.05 only
#   4. ORA (strict DEGs, up and down tested separately), same collections
#        - Main plot  : FDR < 0.05 + redundancy filter
#        - Backup plot: FDR < 0.05 only
# ==============================================================================

set.seed(42)

# ==============================================================================
# 0. Packages
# ==============================================================================

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(limma)
  library(dplyr)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(ggrepel)
  library(pheatmap)
  library(stringr)
  library(clusterProfiler)
  library(msigdbr)
  library(patchwork)
  library(grid)
})


# ==============================================================================
# 1. Parameters
# ==============================================================================

FDR_CUTOFF               <- 0.05
LOGFC_CUTOFF             <- 1

TOP_LABELS_PER_DIRECTION <- 10    # volcano labels per direction
HEATMAP_TOP_N_PER_DIR    <- 50    # heatmap genes per direction
PCA_TOP_VARIABLE_GENES   <- 2000

GSEA_MIN_GS_SIZE         <- 10
GSEA_MAX_GS_SIZE         <- 500

PLOT_TOP_N_MAIN          <- 10    # terms per direction, main plots
JACCARD_CUTOFF           <- 0.5   # terms with Jaccard >= cutoff are "redundant"
LABEL_WRAP_WIDTH         <- 45    # characters per line in pathway labels

# Colours (same logic in every figure)
COL_G3  <- "#C0392B"   # higher in Grade 3
COL_G12 <- "#2874A6"   # higher in Grade 1/2
COL_NS  <- "grey78"

# Curated genes: labelled on the volcano ONLY if they pass the strict cutoff
genes_of_interest <- c("CDH1", "PIK3CA", "ESR1", "GATA3", "FOXA1",
                       "TBX3", "TP53", "ERBB2", "CCND1", "MYC")


# ==============================================================================
# 2. Input / output
# ==============================================================================

base_dir      <- "/ix1/alee/LO_LAB/Personal/Rahul/pILC/MetaBric"
clinical_file <- file.path(base_dir, "data_clinical_sample.txt")
expr_file     <- file.path(base_dir, "data_mrna_agilent_microarray.txt")

outdir   <- file.path(base_dir, "Grade1_2_vs_Grade3")
gsea_dir <- file.path(outdir, "GSEA")
ora_dir  <- file.path(outdir, "ORA")

for (d in c(outdir, gsea_dir, ora_dir)) {
  dir.create(d, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
}

# Save a ggplot as PDF + PNG
save_fig <- function(p, path_no_ext, width, height, dpi = 600) {
  ggsave(paste0(path_no_ext, ".pdf"), p, width = width, height = height)
  ggsave(paste0(path_no_ext, ".png"), p, width = width, height = height, dpi = dpi)
}

# Shared theme
theme_pub <- function(base_size = 12) {
  theme_classic(base_size = base_size) +
    theme(
      plot.title    = element_text(face = "bold", size = base_size + 2),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(size = base_size - 3, color = "grey30"),
      axis.text     = element_text(color = "black"),
      legend.key.height = unit(0.5, "cm")
    )
}


# ==============================================================================
# 3. Read clinical data and define groups
# ==============================================================================

clinical <- read.delim(
  clinical_file, header = TRUE, sep = "\t", comment.char = "#",
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE, check.names = FALSE
)

stopifnot(all(c("SAMPLE_ID", "GRADE") %in% colnames(clinical)))

clinical$GRADE_numeric <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(clinical$GRADE))

clinical$Grade_group <- case_when(
  clinical$GRADE_numeric %in% c(1, 2) ~ "Grade1_2",
  clinical$GRADE_numeric == 3         ~ "Grade3",
  TRUE                                ~ NA_character_
)

cat("\nOriginal grade distribution\n")
print(table(clinical$GRADE_numeric, useNA = "ifany"))

clinical_use <- clinical %>% filter(!is.na(Grade_group))
clinical_use$Grade_group <- factor(clinical_use$Grade_group,
                                   levels = c("Grade1_2", "Grade3"))


# ==============================================================================
# 4. Read expression and match samples
# ==============================================================================

expr_raw <- read.delim(
  expr_file, header = TRUE, sep = "\t",
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE, check.names = FALSE
)

stopifnot(all(c("Hugo_Symbol", "Entrez_Gene_Id") %in% colnames(expr_raw)))

sample_columns <- setdiff(colnames(expr_raw), c("Hugo_Symbol", "Entrez_Gene_Id"))
common_samples <- sample_columns[sample_columns %in% clinical_use$SAMPLE_ID]

metadata <- clinical_use[match(common_samples, clinical_use$SAMPLE_ID), ]
stopifnot(identical(metadata$SAMPLE_ID, common_samples))

cat("\nFinal sample counts\n")
print(table(metadata$Grade_group))
print(table(metadata$GRADE_numeric))

# Matching audit (paired with the samples-used table)
audit_summary <- data.frame(
  Metric = c("Total_clinical", "Clinical_Grade1", "Clinical_Grade2",
             "Clinical_Grade3", "Expression_samples", "Matched_Grade1",
             "Matched_Grade2", "Matched_Grade3", "Final_Grade1_2",
             "Final_Grade3", "Final_total"),
  N = c(nrow(clinical),
        sum(clinical$GRADE_numeric == 1, na.rm = TRUE),
        sum(clinical$GRADE_numeric == 2, na.rm = TRUE),
        sum(clinical$GRADE_numeric == 3, na.rm = TRUE),
        length(sample_columns),
        sum(metadata$GRADE_numeric == 1),
        sum(metadata$GRADE_numeric == 2),
        sum(metadata$GRADE_numeric == 3),
        sum(metadata$Grade_group == "Grade1_2"),
        sum(metadata$Grade_group == "Grade3"),
        nrow(metadata))
)

write.csv(audit_summary, file.path(outdir, "01_sample_matching_audit.csv"),
          row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(metadata, file.path(outdir, "02_samples_used.csv"), row.names = FALSE)

n_g12 <- sum(metadata$Grade_group == "Grade1_2")
n_g3  <- sum(metadata$Grade_group == "Grade3")


# ==============================================================================
# 5. Expression matrix, gene QC and filtering
# ==============================================================================

expr <- as.matrix(expr_raw[, common_samples, drop = FALSE])
storage.mode(expr) <- "numeric"
stopifnot(identical(colnames(expr), metadata$SAMPLE_ID))

gene_symbols <- expr_raw$Hugo_Symbol
valid_gene   <- !is.na(gene_symbols) & gene_symbols != ""

expr         <- expr[valid_gene, , drop = FALSE]
gene_symbols <- gene_symbols[valid_gene]
rownames(expr) <- gene_symbols

cat("\nDuplicated gene symbols:", sum(duplicated(gene_symbols)), "\n")

# Average duplicate gene symbols
if (anyDuplicated(gene_symbols) > 0) {
  expr <- avereps(expr, ID = rownames(expr))
}

# Keep genes measured in >= 80% of samples
expr <- expr[rowMeans(!is.na(expr)) >= 0.80, , drop = FALSE]

# Remove zero-variance genes
gene_variance <- apply(expr, 1, var, na.rm = TRUE)
expr <- expr[!is.na(gene_variance) & gene_variance > 0, , drop = FALSE]

cat("Genes entering limma:", nrow(expr), "\n")


# ==============================================================================
# 6. limma differential expression
# ==============================================================================

group  <- metadata$Grade_group
design <- model.matrix(~ 0 + group)
colnames(design) <- levels(group)
rownames(design) <- metadata$SAMPLE_ID

fit <- lmFit(expr, design)

contrast_matrix <- makeContrasts(
  Grade3_vs_Grade1_2 = Grade3 - Grade1_2,
  levels = design
)

fit2 <- contrasts.fit(fit, contrast_matrix)
fit2 <- eBayes(fit2, trend = TRUE)

DE <- topTable(fit2, coef = "Grade3_vs_Grade1_2", number = Inf,
               adjust.method = "BH", sort.by = "P")

DE$Gene <- rownames(DE)
DE <- DE[, c("Gene", setdiff(colnames(DE), "Gene"))]

# Strict DEG definition
DE <- DE %>%
  mutate(
    Significance = case_when(
      adj.P.Val < FDR_CUTOFF & logFC >=  LOGFC_CUTOFF ~ "Higher in Grade 3",
      adj.P.Val < FDR_CUTOFF & logFC <= -LOGFC_CUTOFF ~ "Higher in Grade 1/2",
      TRUE                                            ~ "Not significant"
    ),
    Significance = factor(Significance,
                          levels = c("Higher in Grade 3",
                                     "Higher in Grade 1/2",
                                     "Not significant"))
  )

DE_sig        <- DE %>% filter(Significance != "Not significant")
Grade3_high   <- DE %>% filter(Significance == "Higher in Grade 3")
Grade1_2_high <- DE %>% filter(Significance == "Higher in Grade 1/2")

cat("\nSTRICT DEG COUNTS (BH FDR < 0.05 AND |logFC| >= 1)\n")
print(table(DE$Significance))

write.csv(DE,            file.path(outdir, "04_limma_all_genes.csv"),        row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(DE_sig,        file.path(outdir, "05_DEG_FDR0.05_logFC1.csv"),     row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(Grade3_high,   file.path(outdir, "06_Grade3_high_DEG.csv"),        row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(Grade1_2_high, file.path(outdir, "07_Grade1_2_high_DEG.csv"),      row.names = FALSE)


# ==============================================================================
# 7. PCA
# ==============================================================================

expr_pca <- expr[rowSums(is.na(expr)) == 0, , drop = FALSE]
pca_var  <- apply(expr_pca, 1, var)

top_pca_genes <- names(sort(pca_var, decreasing = TRUE))[
  seq_len(min(PCA_TOP_VARIABLE_GENES, length(pca_var)))
]

pca <- prcomp(t(expr_pca[top_pca_genes, , drop = FALSE]),
              center = TRUE, scale. = FALSE)

pca_percent <- 100 * pca$sdev^2 / sum(pca$sdev^2)

pca_df <- data.frame(
  SAMPLE_ID   = rownames(pca$x),
  PC1         = pca$x[, 1],
  PC2         = pca$x[, 2],
  Grade_group = metadata$Grade_group[match(rownames(pca$x), metadata$SAMPLE_ID)]
)

write.csv(pca_df, file.path(outdir, "03_PCA_coordinates.csv"), row.names = FALSE)

grade_cols   <- c(Grade1_2 = COL_G12, Grade3 = COL_G3)
grade_labels <- c(Grade1_2 = paste0("Grade 1/2 (n = ", n_g12, ")"),
                  Grade3   = paste0("Grade 3 (n = ", n_g3, ")"))

p_pca <- ggplot(pca_df, aes(PC1, PC2, color = Grade_group)) +
  geom_point(size = 1.8, alpha = 0.6) +
  stat_ellipse(level = 0.95, linewidth = 0.7) +
  scale_color_manual(values = grade_cols, labels = grade_labels, name = NULL) +
  labs(
    title    = "METABRIC: principal component analysis",
    subtitle = paste0("Top ", length(top_pca_genes),
                      " most variable genes; ellipses = 95% confidence"),
    x = paste0("PC1 (", round(pca_percent[1], 1), "%)"),
    y = paste0("PC2 (", round(pca_percent[2], 1), "%)")
  ) +
  theme_pub() +
  theme(legend.position = "top")

save_fig(p_pca, file.path(outdir, "03_PCA_Grade1_2_vs_Grade3"), 6.5, 6)


# ==============================================================================
# 8. Volcano plot
# ==============================================================================

# Labels: curated genes (only if strict DEG) + top genes per direction (by |t|)
genes_of_interest_sig <- DE_sig %>%
  filter(Gene %in% genes_of_interest) %>% pull(Gene)

top_g3 <- Grade3_high %>%
  arrange(desc(abs(t))) %>% slice_head(n = TOP_LABELS_PER_DIRECTION) %>% pull(Gene)

top_g12 <- Grade1_2_high %>%
  arrange(desc(abs(t))) %>% slice_head(n = TOP_LABELS_PER_DIRECTION) %>% pull(Gene)

genes_to_label <- unique(c(genes_of_interest_sig, top_g3, top_g12))

DE_plot <- DE %>%
  mutate(
    minusLog10FDR = -log10(pmax(adj.P.Val, .Machine$double.xmin)),
    Label = ifelse(Gene %in% genes_to_label, Gene, NA_character_)
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(Significance == "Not significant"))   # draw grey points first

sig_counts <- table(DE$Significance)
volcano_labels <- c(
  "Higher in Grade 3"   = paste0("Higher in Grade 3 (n = ",   sig_counts[["Higher in Grade 3"]],   ")"),
  "Higher in Grade 1/2" = paste0("Higher in Grade 1/2 (n = ", sig_counts[["Higher in Grade 1/2"]], ")"),
  "Not significant"     = "Not significant"
)

p_volcano <- ggplot(DE_plot, aes(logFC, minusLog10FDR, color = Significance)) +
  geom_point(size = 1.4, alpha = 0.65) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = c(-LOGFC_CUTOFF, LOGFC_CUTOFF),
             linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.4) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(FDR_CUTOFF),
             linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.4) +
  geom_text_repel(
    aes(label = Label), size = 3.2, max.overlaps = Inf,
    box.padding = 0.4, point.padding = 0.3, min.segment.length = 0,
    segment.size = 0.3, show.legend = FALSE, color = "black"
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c("Higher in Grade 3" = COL_G3,
               "Higher in Grade 1/2" = COL_G12,
               "Not significant" = COL_NS),
    labels = volcano_labels, name = NULL
  ) +
  labs(
    title    = "METABRIC: Grade 3 vs Grade 1/2",
    subtitle = "BH FDR < 0.05 and |logFC| \u2265 1",
    x = expression(log[2]~"fold change (Grade 3 \u2212 Grade 1/2)"),
    y = expression(-log[10]~"(FDR)")
  ) +
  theme_pub(14) +
  theme(legend.position = "top")

save_fig(p_volcano, file.path(outdir, "08_Volcano_Grade3_vs_Grade1_2"), 8, 7)


# ==============================================================================
# 9. Heatmap (top DEGs per direction, row z-scores)
# ==============================================================================

up_genes   <- Grade3_high %>%
  arrange(desc(abs(t))) %>% slice_head(n = HEATMAP_TOP_N_PER_DIR) %>% pull(Gene)
down_genes <- Grade1_2_high %>%
  arrange(desc(abs(t))) %>% slice_head(n = HEATMAP_TOP_N_PER_DIR) %>% pull(Gene)

heat_genes <- c(up_genes, down_genes)

if (length(heat_genes) >= 2) {

  heat_expr <- expr[heat_genes, , drop = FALSE]
  heat_expr <- heat_expr[rowSums(is.na(heat_expr)) == 0, , drop = FALSE]

  heat_z <- t(scale(t(heat_expr)))
  heat_z <- pmax(pmin(heat_z, 2.5), -2.5)      # clip for a stable colour range

  annotation_col <- data.frame(Grade = metadata$Grade_group,
                               row.names = metadata$SAMPLE_ID)

  annotation_row <- data.frame(
    Direction = ifelse(rownames(heat_z) %in% up_genes,
                       "Higher in Grade 3", "Higher in Grade 1/2"),
    row.names = rownames(heat_z)
  )

  annotation_colors <- list(
    Grade     = c(Grade1_2 = COL_G12, Grade3 = COL_G3),
    Direction = c("Higher in Grade 3" = COL_G3, "Higher in Grade 1/2" = COL_G12)
  )

  ph <- pheatmap(
    heat_z,
    annotation_col    = annotation_col,
    annotation_row    = annotation_row,
    annotation_colors = annotation_colors,
    color  = colorRampPalette(c(COL_G12, "white", COL_G3))(100),
    breaks = seq(-2.5, 2.5, length.out = 101),
    show_colnames = FALSE,
    show_rownames = TRUE,
    cluster_rows = TRUE,
    cluster_cols = TRUE,
    clustering_method = "ward.D2",
    fontsize_row = 7,
    border_color = NA,
    main = paste0(nrow(heat_z), " DEGs: Grade 3 vs Grade 1/2 (row z-score)"),
    silent = TRUE
  )

  pdf(file.path(outdir, "09_Heatmap_top_DEGs.pdf"), width = 10, height = 10)
  grid.newpage(); grid.draw(ph$gtable)
  dev.off()

  png(file.path(outdir, "09_Heatmap_top_DEGs.png"),
      width = 10, height = 10, units = "in", res = 300)
  grid.newpage(); grid.draw(ph$gtable)
  dev.off()

  write.csv(
    data.frame(Gene = rownames(heat_z), annotation_row),
    file.path(outdir, "09_Heatmap_genes.csv"), row.names = FALSE
  )

} else {
  message("Fewer than 2 strict DEGs: heatmap skipped.")
}


# ==============================================================================
# 10. Gene-set collections (MSigDB)
# ==============================================================================

msig <- msigdbr(species = "Homo sapiens")

# Column names differ between msigdbr versions
coll_col <- if ("gs_collection" %in% colnames(msig)) "gs_collection" else "gs_cat"
sub_col  <- if ("gs_subcollection" %in% colnames(msig)) "gs_subcollection" else "gs_subcat"

get_t2g <- function(collection, subcollection = NULL) {
  d <- msig[msig[[coll_col]] == collection, ]
  if (!is.null(subcollection)) {
    d <- d[!is.na(d[[sub_col]]) & d[[sub_col]] == subcollection, ]
  }
  d %>% dplyr::select(gs_name, gene_symbol) %>% distinct()
}

# backup_n = terms per direction in the backup plot (Inf = all significant)
collections <- list(
  Hallmark = list(t2g = get_t2g("H"),
                  prefix = "HALLMARK", label = "Hallmark",
                  backup_n = Inf, side_by_side = TRUE),
  Reactome = list(t2g = get_t2g("C2", "CP:REACTOME"),
                  prefix = "REACTOME", label = "Reactome",
                  backup_n = 20, side_by_side = FALSE),
  GO_BP    = list(t2g = get_t2g("C5", "GO:BP"),
                  prefix = "GOBP", label = "GO Biological Process",
                  backup_n = 20, side_by_side = FALSE),
  GO_MF    = list(t2g = get_t2g("C5", "GO:MF"),
                  prefix = "GOMF", label = "GO Molecular Function",
                  backup_n = 20, side_by_side = FALSE),
  GO_CC    = list(t2g = get_t2g("C5", "GO:CC"),
                  prefix = "GOCC", label = "GO Cellular Component",
                  backup_n = 20, side_by_side = FALSE)
)

for (nm in names(collections)) {
  n_sets <- length(unique(collections[[nm]]$t2g$gs_name))
  cat(nm, ": ", n_sets, " gene sets\n", sep = "")
  stopifnot(n_sets > 0)
}


# ==============================================================================
# 11. Plot helpers (label cleaning, redundancy filter)
# ==============================================================================

# Make pathway names readable
clean_term <- function(x, prefix) {
  x <- sub(paste0("^", prefix, "_"), "", x)
  x <- tolower(gsub("_", " ", x))
  x <- paste0(toupper(substring(x, 1, 1)), substring(x, 2))

  # Words that must keep their special capitalisation (extend as needed)
  acronyms <- c(
    "DNA", "RNA", "mRNA", "tRNA", "rRNA", "ncRNA", "miRNA", "ATP", "GTP",
    "GTPase", "NADH", "TGF", "TNF", "TNFa", "NFkB", "IL2", "IL6", "STAT3",
    "STAT5", "JAK", "KRAS", "MYC", "E2F", "G2M", "mTORC1", "mTOR", "p53",
    "UV", "PI3K", "AKT", "MAPK", "WNT", "NOTCH", "ER", "MHC", "ECM", "TCA",
    "TLR", "NMD", "HIV", "Fc"
  )
  for (a in acronyms) {
    x <- gsub(paste0("\\b", a, "\\b"), a, x, ignore.case = TRUE, perl = TRUE)
  }
  x
}

# Remove redundant terms by leading-edge / hit-gene Jaccard overlap.
# df must be sorted best first and contain a 'core_enrichment' column ("/" separated).
reduce_redundancy <- function(df, cutoff, max_keep = Inf) {

  if (nrow(df) <= 1) return(df)

  gene_lists <- strsplit(df$core_enrichment, "/")
  keep       <- rep(FALSE, nrow(df))
  kept_idx   <- integer(0)

  for (i in seq_len(nrow(df))) {

    redundant <- FALSE
    for (j in kept_idx) {
      jac <- length(intersect(gene_lists[[i]], gene_lists[[j]])) /
        length(union(gene_lists[[i]], gene_lists[[j]]))
      if (jac >= cutoff) { redundant <- TRUE; break }
    }

    if (!redundant) {
      keep[i]  <- TRUE
      kept_idx <- c(kept_idx, i)
      if (length(kept_idx) >= max_keep) break   # enough terms collected
    }
  }

  df[keep, , drop = FALSE]
}

dir_levels <- c("Higher in Grade 3", "Higher in Grade 1/2")

# Height scales with the number of terms so labels never collide
fig_height <- function(n_terms) max(4, 0.42 * n_terms + 1.8)


# ==============================================================================
# 12. GSEA
# ==============================================================================

# Ranked list: ALL tested genes, limma moderated t-statistic
gene_rank <- DE$t
names(gene_rank) <- DE$Gene
gene_rank <- sort(gene_rank[!is.na(gene_rank) & !is.na(names(gene_rank))],
                  decreasing = TRUE)

write.table(
  data.frame(Gene = names(gene_rank), limma_t = gene_rank),
  file.path(gsea_dir, "GSEA_ranked_all_genes_limma_t.tsv"),
  sep = "\t", quote = FALSE, row.names = FALSE
)

run_gsea <- function(gene_rank, t2g, name) {

  cat("\nRunning GSEA:", name, "\n")
  set.seed(42)

  gsea <- GSEA(
    geneList      = gene_rank,
    TERM2GENE     = t2g,
    minGSSize     = GSEA_MIN_GS_SIZE,
    maxGSSize     = GSEA_MAX_GS_SIZE,
    pvalueCutoff  = 1,
    pAdjustMethod = "BH",
    eps           = 0,
    seed          = TRUE,
    verbose       = FALSE
  )

  gsea_df <- as.data.frame(gsea)
  gsea_df$Direction <- ifelse(gsea_df$NES > 0, "Higher in Grade 3", "Higher in Grade 1/2")

  write.csv(gsea_df, file.path(gsea_dir, paste0(name, "_GSEA_all_pathways.csv")),
            row.names = FALSE)
  write.csv(gsea_df %>% filter(p.adjust < FDR_CUTOFF),
            file.path(gsea_dir, paste0(name, "_GSEA_FDR0.05.csv")),
            row.names = FALSE)

  cat("Significant pathways:", sum(gsea_df$p.adjust < FDR_CUTOFF, na.rm = TRUE), "\n")
  cat("Pathways with NA p.adjust:", sum(is.na(gsea_df$p.adjust)), "\n")
  gsea
}

# Build one GSEA lollipop plot (no saving)
build_gsea_plot <- function(gsea_obj, label, prefix, top_n, remove_redundant) {

  res <- as.data.frame(gsea_obj) %>%
    filter(p.adjust < FDR_CUTOFF) %>%
    arrange(p.adjust, desc(abs(NES)))

  if (nrow(res) == 0) return(NULL)

  select_terms <- function(d) {
    if (nrow(d) == 0) return(d)
    if (remove_redundant) d <- reduce_redundancy(d, JACCARD_CUTOFF, max_keep = top_n)
    slice_head(d, n = min(top_n, nrow(d)))
  }

  plot_df <- bind_rows(select_terms(filter(res, NES > 0)),
                       select_terms(filter(res, NES < 0))) %>%
    mutate(
      Direction     = factor(ifelse(NES > 0, dir_levels[1], dir_levels[2]),
                             levels = dir_levels),
      Term          = str_wrap(clean_term(ID, prefix), width = LABEL_WRAP_WIDTH),
      minusLog10FDR = -log10(pmax(p.adjust, 1e-300))
    )

  plot_df$Term <- factor(plot_df$Term, levels = unique(plot_df$Term[order(plot_df$NES)]))

  top_text <- ifelse(is.infinite(top_n), "all significant terms",
                     paste0("top ", top_n, " per direction"))

  subtitle_text <- if (remove_redundant) {
    paste0("Ranked by limma t; FDR < ", FDR_CUTOFF,
           "; non-redundant (leading-edge Jaccard < ", JACCARD_CUTOFF, "); ", top_text)
  } else {
    paste0("Ranked by limma t; FDR < ", FDR_CUTOFF, "; no redundancy filter; ", top_text)
  }

  p <- ggplot(plot_df, aes(NES, Term, color = Direction)) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 0, color = "grey30", linewidth = 0.4) +
    geom_segment(aes(x = 0, xend = NES, yend = Term), linewidth = 0.9) +
    geom_point(aes(size = minusLog10FDR)) +
    scale_color_manual(values = c("Higher in Grade 3" = COL_G3,
                                  "Higher in Grade 1/2" = COL_G12), name = NULL) +
    scale_size_continuous(range = c(3, 8), name = expression(-log[10]~"(FDR)")) +
    scale_x_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = 0.08)) +
    labs(title = paste0(label, " GSEA: Grade 3 vs Grade 1/2"),
         subtitle = subtitle_text,
         x = "Normalized enrichment score (NES)", y = NULL) +
    theme_pub() +
    theme(axis.text.y = element_text(size = 10, lineheight = 0.9),
          panel.grid.major.x = element_line(color = "grey90", linewidth = 0.3))

  list(plot = p, data = plot_df)
}

# Main + backup (+ optional side-by-side); returns one summary row
plot_gsea_main_and_backup <- function(gsea_obj, name, cfg) {

  res_sig <- as.data.frame(gsea_obj) %>% filter(p.adjust < FDR_CUTOFF)

  summary_row <- data.frame(
    Collection = name,
    Significant_total = nrow(res_sig),
    Significant_Grade3 = sum(res_sig$NES > 0),
    Significant_Grade1_2 = sum(res_sig$NES < 0),
    Main_plot_terms = 0L, Backup_plot_terms = 0L
  )

  main   <- build_gsea_plot(gsea_obj, cfg$label, cfg$prefix,
                            top_n = PLOT_TOP_N_MAIN, remove_redundant = TRUE)
  backup <- build_gsea_plot(gsea_obj, cfg$label, cfg$prefix,
                            top_n = cfg$backup_n, remove_redundant = FALSE)

  if (is.null(main) || is.null(backup)) {
    message("No significant GSEA pathways for ", name)
    return(summary_row)
  }

  cols <- c("ID", "Term", "NES", "p.adjust", "setSize", "Direction")

  write.csv(main$data[, cols],
            file.path(gsea_dir, paste0(name, "_GSEA_main_plot_data.csv")), row.names = FALSE)
  write.csv(backup$data[, cols],
            file.path(gsea_dir, paste0(name, "_GSEA_backup_plot_data.csv")), row.names = FALSE)

  save_fig(main$plot,
           file.path(gsea_dir, paste0(name, "_GSEA_main_FDR0.05_nonredundant")),
           10, fig_height(nrow(main$data)))

  save_fig(backup$plot,
           file.path(gsea_dir, paste0(name, "_GSEA_backup_FDR0.05_all")),
           10, fig_height(nrow(backup$data)))

  if (isTRUE(cfg$side_by_side)) {
    combined <- (backup$plot | main$plot) +
      plot_layout(guides = "collect") & theme(legend.position = "right")
    save_fig(combined,
             file.path(gsea_dir, paste0(name, "_GSEA_backup_vs_main_side_by_side")),
             20, fig_height(max(nrow(main$data), nrow(backup$data))))
  }

  summary_row$Main_plot_terms   <- nrow(main$data)
  summary_row$Backup_plot_terms <- nrow(backup$data)
  summary_row
}

gsea_results <- list()
gsea_summary <- list()

for (nm in names(collections)) {
  gsea_results[[nm]] <- run_gsea(gene_rank, collections[[nm]]$t2g, nm)
  gsea_summary[[nm]] <- plot_gsea_main_and_backup(gsea_results[[nm]], nm, collections[[nm]])
}

gsea_summary <- bind_rows(gsea_summary)
write.csv(gsea_summary, file.path(gsea_dir, "GSEA_summary_counts.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
print(gsea_summary)


# ==============================================================================
# 13. ORA (strict DEGs; up and down tested separately)
#     Universe = all genes tested by limma
# ==============================================================================

gene_universe <- unique(DE$Gene[!is.na(DE$Gene) & DE$Gene != ""])
grade3_genes  <- unique(Grade3_high$Gene)
grade12_genes <- unique(Grade1_2_high$Gene)

cat("\nORA input: Grade 3-up genes =", length(grade3_genes),
    "; Grade 1/2-up genes =", length(grade12_genes), "\n")

# Convert "k/n" strings to numbers
ratio_to_num <- function(s) {
  vapply(strsplit(s, "/"),
         function(z) as.numeric(z[1]) / as.numeric(z[2]), numeric(1))
}

run_ora_one <- function(genes, t2g, direction) {

  if (length(genes) < 2) return(NULL)

  x <- enricher(
    gene = genes, universe = gene_universe, TERM2GENE = t2g,
    pAdjustMethod = "BH", pvalueCutoff = 1, qvalueCutoff = 1,
    minGSSize = GSEA_MIN_GS_SIZE, maxGSSize = GSEA_MAX_GS_SIZE
  )

  if (is.null(x)) return(NULL)

  df <- as.data.frame(x)
  if (nrow(df) == 0) return(NULL)

  df$Direction      <- direction
  df$FoldEnrichment <- ratio_to_num(df$GeneRatio) / ratio_to_num(df$BgRatio)
  df
}

build_ora_plot <- function(ora_df, label, prefix, top_n, remove_redundant) {

  res <- ora_df %>%
    filter(p.adjust < FDR_CUTOFF) %>%
    arrange(p.adjust, desc(FoldEnrichment)) %>%
    mutate(core_enrichment = geneID)          # reuse the redundancy function

  if (nrow(res) == 0) return(NULL)

  select_terms <- function(d) {
    if (nrow(d) == 0) return(d)
    if (remove_redundant) d <- reduce_redundancy(d, JACCARD_CUTOFF, max_keep = top_n)
    slice_head(d, n = min(top_n, nrow(d)))
  }

  plot_df <- bind_rows(select_terms(filter(res, Direction == dir_levels[1])),
                       select_terms(filter(res, Direction == dir_levels[2]))) %>%
    mutate(
      Direction     = factor(Direction, levels = dir_levels),
      Term          = str_wrap(clean_term(ID, prefix), width = LABEL_WRAP_WIDTH),
      minusLog10FDR = -log10(pmax(p.adjust, 1e-300))
    )

  plot_df$Term <- factor(
    plot_df$Term,
    levels = unique(plot_df$Term[order(plot_df$Direction, plot_df$FoldEnrichment)])
  )

  top_text <- ifelse(is.infinite(top_n), "all significant terms",
                     paste0("top ", top_n, " per direction"))

  subtitle_text <- if (remove_redundant) {
    paste0("Strict DEGs (FDR < ", FDR_CUTOFF, ", |logFC| \u2265 ", LOGFC_CUTOFF,
           "); ORA FDR < ", FDR_CUTOFF,
           "; non-redundant (Jaccard < ", JACCARD_CUTOFF, "); ", top_text)
  } else {
    paste0("Strict DEGs (FDR < ", FDR_CUTOFF, ", |logFC| \u2265 ", LOGFC_CUTOFF,
           "); ORA FDR < ", FDR_CUTOFF, "; no redundancy filter; ", top_text)
  }

  p <- ggplot(plot_df, aes(FoldEnrichment, Term)) +
    geom_point(aes(size = Count, fill = minusLog10FDR),
               shape = 21, color = "black", stroke = 0.3) +
    facet_grid(Direction ~ ., scales = "free_y", space = "free_y") +
    scale_fill_gradient(low = "#FEE0D2", high = "#A50F15",
                        name = expression(-log[10]~"(FDR)")) +
    scale_size_continuous(range = c(3, 9), name = "Gene count") +
    scale_x_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0.05, 0.12))) +
    labs(title = paste0(label, " ORA: Grade 3 vs Grade 1/2"),
         subtitle = subtitle_text,
         x = "Fold enrichment", y = NULL) +
    theme_pub() +
    theme(axis.text.y = element_text(size = 10, lineheight = 0.9),
          strip.background = element_rect(fill = "grey92", color = NA),
          strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"),
          panel.grid.major.x = element_line(color = "grey90", linewidth = 0.3))

  list(plot = p, data = plot_df)
}

run_ora_collection <- function(name, cfg) {

  cat("\nRunning ORA:", name, "\n")

  ora_df <- bind_rows(
    run_ora_one(grade3_genes,  cfg$t2g, dir_levels[1]),
    run_ora_one(grade12_genes, cfg$t2g, dir_levels[2])
  )

  summary_row <- data.frame(
    Collection = name,
    Significant_total = 0L, Significant_Grade3 = 0L, Significant_Grade1_2 = 0L,
    Main_plot_terms = 0L, Backup_plot_terms = 0L
  )

  if (is.null(ora_df) || nrow(ora_df) == 0) {
    message("No ORA results for ", name)
    return(summary_row)
  }

  write.csv(ora_df, file.path(ora_dir, paste0("ORA_", name, "_all.csv")), row.names = FALSE)

  ora_sig <- ora_df %>% filter(p.adjust < FDR_CUTOFF)
  write.csv(ora_sig, file.path(ora_dir, paste0("ORA_", name, "_FDR0.05.csv")), row.names = FALSE)

  summary_row$Significant_total    <- nrow(ora_sig)
  summary_row$Significant_Grade3   <- sum(ora_sig$Direction == dir_levels[1])
  summary_row$Significant_Grade1_2 <- sum(ora_sig$Direction == dir_levels[2])

  main   <- build_ora_plot(ora_df, cfg$label, cfg$prefix, PLOT_TOP_N_MAIN, TRUE)
  backup <- build_ora_plot(ora_df, cfg$label, cfg$prefix, cfg$backup_n,    FALSE)

  if (is.null(main) || is.null(backup)) {
    message("No significant ORA terms for ", name)
    return(summary_row)
  }

  cols <- c("ID", "Term", "Direction", "Count", "GeneRatio", "BgRatio",
            "FoldEnrichment", "p.adjust", "geneID")

  write.csv(main$data[, cols],
            file.path(ora_dir, paste0("ORA_", name, "_main_plot_data.csv")), row.names = FALSE)
  write.csv(backup$data[, cols],
            file.path(ora_dir, paste0("ORA_", name, "_backup_plot_data.csv")), row.names = FALSE)

  save_fig(main$plot,
           file.path(ora_dir, paste0("ORA_", name, "_main_FDR0.05_nonredundant")),
           10, fig_height(nrow(main$data)) + 0.6)

  save_fig(backup$plot,
           file.path(ora_dir, paste0("ORA_", name, "_backup_FDR0.05_all")),
           10, fig_height(nrow(backup$data)) + 0.6)

  summary_row$Main_plot_terms   <- nrow(main$data)
  summary_row$Backup_plot_terms <- nrow(backup$data)
  summary_row
}

ora_summary <- bind_rows(lapply(names(collections),
                                function(nm) run_ora_collection(nm, collections[[nm]])))

write.csv(ora_summary, file.path(ora_dir, "ORA_summary_counts.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
print(ora_summary)

             "Genes_tested", "Strict_DEGs", "Grade3_high_DEGs", "Grade1_2_high_DEGs"),
```

```{r}
# ==============================================================================
# METABRIC Grade 3 vs Grade 1/2: chromatin-related pathway analysis
#
# Part A (main)       : chromatin gene sets taken from the full GSEA results
#                       (original FDR, corrected over the whole collection)
# Part B (sensitivity): GSEA rerun ONLY on chromatin gene sets
#                       (FDR corrected within the chromatin family)
# Part C              : leading-edge driver genes, bar plot and volcano highlight
#
# No dates are used in any file name.
# ==============================================================================

stopifnot(
  exists("gsea_results"), exists("collections"), exists("DE"),
  exists("gene_rank"), exists("outdir")
)


# ==============================================================================
# 15. Parameters and output folder
# ==============================================================================

chrom_dir <- file.path(outdir, "Chromatin")
dir.create(chrom_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

# A gene set is "chromatin-related" if its name contains ANY include keyword
# and NONE of the exclude keywords. Edit these lists as needed.
# (MSigDB names are upper case with underscores, e.g. GOBP_NUCLEOSOME_ASSEMBLY)
CHROM_INCLUDE <- c(
  "CHROMATIN", "HISTONE", "NUCLEOSOME", "HETEROCHROMATIN", "EUCHROMATIN",
  "DNA_PACKAGING", "DNA_METHYLATION", "DNA_DEMETHYLATION", "EPIGENETIC",
  "POLYCOMB", "PRC2", "SWI_SNF", "HDAC"
)

# Remove cell-division terms that are not chromatin biology
CHROM_EXCLUDE <- c("SEGREGATION", "SISTER_CHROMATID", "SPINDLE",
                   "KINETOCHORE", "MITOTIC")

CHROM_TOP_N_MAIN   <- 15    # terms per direction, main plot
CHROM_TOP_N_BACKUP <- 30    # terms per direction, backup plot (FDR only)
CHROM_TOP_GENES    <- 15    # driver genes per direction in the bar plot
CHROM_VOLCANO_LABELS <- 10  # labelled chromatin genes per direction

is_chromatin <- function(ids) {
  inc <- grepl(paste(CHROM_INCLUDE, collapse = "|"), ids)
  exc <- grepl(paste(CHROM_EXCLUDE, collapse = "|"), ids)
  inc & !exc
}

# Short collection tags used in plot labels
coll_tag   <- c(Hallmark = "Hallmark", Reactome = "Reactome",
                GO_BP = "GO-BP", GO_MF = "GO-MF", GO_CC = "GO-CC")
prefix_map <- vapply(collections, function(x) x$prefix, character(1))

dir_levels <- c("Higher in Grade 3", "Higher in Grade 1/2")


# ==============================================================================
# 16. Part A: chromatin gene sets from the full GSEA results
# ==============================================================================

chrom_all <- bind_rows(lapply(names(collections), function(nm) {
  df <- as.data.frame(gsea_results[[nm]])
  df <- df[is_chromatin(df$ID), , drop = FALSE]
  if (nrow(df) == 0) return(NULL)
  df$Collection <- nm
  df
}))

stopifnot(nrow(chrom_all) > 0)

chrom_all <- chrom_all %>%
  mutate(
    Direction  = ifelse(NES > 0, dir_levels[1], dir_levels[2]),
    Term_clean = mapply(clean_term, ID, prefix_map[Collection], USE.NAMES = FALSE)
  ) %>%
  arrange(p.adjust, desc(abs(NES)))

chrom_sig <- chrom_all %>% filter(p.adjust < FDR_CUTOFF)

# Paired tables: everything tested, and the significant subset
write.csv(chrom_all %>% dplyr::select(-core_enrichment),
          file.path(chrom_dir, "Chromatin_terms_tested_all.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(chrom_sig,
          file.path(chrom_dir, "Chromatin_terms_FDR0.05.csv"), row.names = FALSE)

# Counts per collection (check the selected terms before interpreting)
chrom_counts <- chrom_all %>%
  group_by(Collection) %>%
  summarise(
    Chromatin_sets_tested = n(),
    Significant_total     = sum(p.adjust < FDR_CUTOFF),
    Significant_Grade3    = sum(p.adjust < FDR_CUTOFF & NES > 0),
    Significant_Grade1_2  = sum(p.adjust < FDR_CUTOFF & NES < 0),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

write.csv(chrom_counts, file.path(chrom_dir, "Chromatin_summary_counts.csv"),
          row.names = FALSE)
cat("\nChromatin gene sets (Part A, original FDR)\n")
print(chrom_counts)


# ---- Lollipop plot function (works for Part A and Part B) --------------------
plot_chromatin_lollipop <- function(df, top_n, remove_redundant, title, fdr_text) {

  res <- df %>%
    filter(p.adjust < FDR_CUTOFF) %>%
    arrange(p.adjust, desc(abs(NES)))

  if (nrow(res) == 0) return(NULL)

  select_terms <- function(d) {
    if (nrow(d) == 0) return(d)
    if (remove_redundant) d <- reduce_redundancy(d, JACCARD_CUTOFF, max_keep = top_n)
    slice_head(d, n = min(top_n, nrow(d)))
  }

  plot_df <- bind_rows(select_terms(filter(res, NES > 0)),
                       select_terms(filter(res, NES < 0))) %>%
    mutate(
      Direction     = factor(ifelse(NES > 0, dir_levels[1], dir_levels[2]),
                             levels = dir_levels),
      Term          = str_wrap(
                        paste0(Term_clean, " [", unname(coll_tag[Collection]), "]"),
                        width = LABEL_WRAP_WIDTH),
      minusLog10FDR = -log10(pmax(p.adjust, 1e-300))
    )

  plot_df$Term <- factor(plot_df$Term,
                         levels = unique(plot_df$Term[order(plot_df$NES)]))

  top_text <- paste0("top ", top_n, " per direction")
  filter_text <- if (remove_redundant) {
    paste0("non-redundant (leading-edge Jaccard < ", JACCARD_CUTOFF, ")")
  } else {
    "no redundancy filter"
  }

  p <- ggplot(plot_df, aes(NES, Term, color = Direction)) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 0, color = "grey30", linewidth = 0.4) +
    geom_segment(aes(x = 0, xend = NES, yend = Term), linewidth = 0.9) +
    geom_point(aes(size = minusLog10FDR)) +
    scale_color_manual(values = c("Higher in Grade 3" = COL_G3,
                                  "Higher in Grade 1/2" = COL_G12), name = NULL) +
    scale_size_continuous(range = c(3, 8), name = expression(-log[10]~"(FDR)")) +
    scale_x_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = 0.08)) +
    labs(title = title,
         subtitle = paste0(fdr_text, "; ", filter_text, "; ", top_text),
         x = "Normalized enrichment score (NES)", y = NULL) +
    theme_pub() +
    theme(axis.text.y = element_text(size = 10, lineheight = 0.9),
          panel.grid.major.x = element_line(color = "grey90", linewidth = 0.3))

  list(plot = p, data = plot_df)
}

save_chromatin_plot <- function(res, tag) {
  if (is.null(res)) return(invisible(NULL))
  save_fig(res$plot, file.path(chrom_dir, tag), 10, fig_height(nrow(res$data)))
  write.csv(
    res$data %>% dplyr::select(ID, Term, Collection, NES, p.adjust, setSize, Direction),
    file.path(chrom_dir, paste0(tag, "_plot_data.csv")), row.names = FALSE
  )
}

fdr_text_A <- paste0("GSEA ranked by limma t; FDR < ", FDR_CUTOFF,
                     " (corrected within each full collection)")

main_A <- plot_chromatin_lollipop(
  chrom_all, CHROM_TOP_N_MAIN, TRUE,
  "Chromatin-related pathways: Grade 3 vs Grade 1/2", fdr_text_A
)
backup_A <- plot_chromatin_lollipop(
  chrom_all, CHROM_TOP_N_BACKUP, FALSE,
  "Chromatin-related pathways: Grade 3 vs Grade 1/2", fdr_text_A
)

save_chromatin_plot(main_A,   "Chromatin_GSEA_main_FDR0.05_nonredundant")
save_chromatin_plot(backup_A, "Chromatin_GSEA_backup_FDR0.05_all")


# ==============================================================================
# 17. Part B (sensitivity): GSEA restricted to chromatin gene sets
#    FDR is corrected within the chromatin family only
# ==============================================================================

chrom_t2g_list <- lapply(names(collections), function(nm) {
  t2g <- collections[[nm]]$t2g
  t2g <- t2g[is_chromatin(t2g$gs_name), , drop = FALSE]
  if (nrow(t2g) == 0) return(NULL)
  t2g$Collection <- nm
  t2g
})

chrom_t2g_all <- bind_rows(chrom_t2g_list)

set_to_collection <- chrom_t2g_all %>%
  distinct(gs_name, Collection) %>%
  { setNames(.$Collection, .$gs_name) }

cat("\nChromatin gene sets available for restricted GSEA:",
    length(set_to_collection), "\n")

set.seed(42)
gsea_chrom <- GSEA(
  geneList      = gene_rank,
  TERM2GENE     = chrom_t2g_all[, c("gs_name", "gene_symbol")],
  minGSSize     = GSEA_MIN_GS_SIZE,
  maxGSSize     = GSEA_MAX_GS_SIZE,
  pvalueCutoff  = 1,
  pAdjustMethod = "BH",
  eps           = 0,
  seed          = TRUE,
  verbose       = FALSE
)

chrom_B <- as.data.frame(gsea_chrom)

if (nrow(chrom_B) > 0) {

  chrom_B <- chrom_B %>%
    mutate(
      Collection = unname(set_to_collection[ID]),
      Direction  = ifelse(NES > 0, dir_levels[1], dir_levels[2]),
      Term_clean = mapply(clean_term, ID, prefix_map[Collection], USE.NAMES = FALSE)
    ) %>%
    arrange(p.adjust, desc(abs(NES)))

  # Put the original (full-collection) FDR next to the restricted FDR
  chrom_B$FDR_full_collection <- chrom_all$p.adjust[match(chrom_B$ID, chrom_all$ID)]

  write.csv(
    chrom_B %>% dplyr::select(-core_enrichment) %>%
      dplyr::rename(FDR_chromatin_family = p.adjust),
    file.path(chrom_dir, "Chromatin_restricted_GSEA_all.csv"), row.names = FALSE
  )

  cat("Restricted GSEA: significant within chromatin family =",
      sum(chrom_B$p.adjust < FDR_CUTOFF, na.rm = TRUE),
      "(Grade 3:", sum(chrom_B$p.adjust < FDR_CUTOFF & chrom_B$NES > 0, na.rm = TRUE),
      "; Grade 1/2:", sum(chrom_B$p.adjust < FDR_CUTOFF & chrom_B$NES < 0, na.rm = TRUE),
      ")\n")

  fdr_text_B <- paste0("restricted GSEA; FDR < ", FDR_CUTOFF,
                       " (corrected within chromatin gene sets only)")

  main_B <- plot_chromatin_lollipop(
    chrom_B, CHROM_TOP_N_MAIN, TRUE,
    "Chromatin gene sets (sensitivity): Grade 3 vs Grade 1/2", fdr_text_B
  )

  save_chromatin_plot(main_B, "Chromatin_restricted_GSEA_main_FDR0.05_nonredundant")
}


# ==============================================================================
# 18. Part C: leading-edge driver genes (from Part A significant pathways)
# ==============================================================================

if (nrow(chrom_sig) > 0) {

  le_long <- bind_rows(lapply(seq_len(nrow(chrom_sig)), function(i) {
    data.frame(
      Gene      = strsplit(chrom_sig$core_enrichment[i], "/")[[1]],
      ID        = chrom_sig$ID[i],
      Direction = chrom_sig$Direction[i],
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
  })) %>% distinct()

  # In how many significant chromatin pathways does each gene appear?
  le_freq <- le_long %>%
    group_by(Gene, Direction) %>%
    summarise(N_pathways = n_distinct(ID), .groups = "drop") %>%
    left_join(DE %>% dplyr::select(Gene, logFC, t, adj.P.Val), by = "Gene") %>%
    mutate(Direction = factor(Direction, levels = dir_levels)) %>%
    arrange(Direction, desc(N_pathways), desc(abs(t)))

  write.csv(le_freq, file.path(chrom_dir, "Chromatin_leading_edge_gene_frequency.csv"),
            row.names = FALSE)

  # ---- Bar plot: top driver genes per direction ----
  bar_df <- le_freq %>%
    group_by(Direction) %>%
    slice_head(n = CHROM_TOP_GENES) %>%
    ungroup()

  bar_df$Gene <- factor(
    bar_df$Gene,
    levels = unique(bar_df$Gene[order(bar_df$Direction, bar_df$N_pathways)])
  )

  p_bar <- ggplot(bar_df, aes(N_pathways, Gene, fill = Direction)) +
    geom_col(width = 0.7) +
    facet_grid(Direction ~ ., scales = "free_y", space = "free_y") +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c("Higher in Grade 3" = COL_G3,
                                 "Higher in Grade 1/2" = COL_G12), guide = "none") +
    scale_x_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.08))) +
    labs(title = "Chromatin leading-edge driver genes",
         subtitle = "Number of significant chromatin pathways containing each gene in its leading edge",
         x = "Number of significant chromatin pathways", y = NULL) +
    theme_pub() +
    theme(strip.background = element_rect(fill = "grey92", color = NA),
          strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"),
          axis.text.y = element_text(size = 10))

  save_fig(p_bar, file.path(chrom_dir, "Chromatin_driver_genes_barplot"),
           7, fig_height(nrow(bar_df)))

  # ---- Volcano: chromatin leading-edge genes highlighted ----
  le_genes <- unique(le_long$Gene)

  grp_levels <- c("Chromatin gene, higher in Grade 3",
                  "Chromatin gene, higher in Grade 1/2",
                  "Other genes")

  DE_chr <- DE %>%
    mutate(
      Chromatin     = Gene %in% le_genes,
      minusLog10FDR = -log10(pmax(adj.P.Val, .Machine$double.xmin)),
      Group = factor(case_when(
        Chromatin & t > 0 ~ grp_levels[1],
        Chromatin & t < 0 ~ grp_levels[2],
        TRUE              ~ grp_levels[3]
      ), levels = grp_levels)
    )

  lab_up   <- DE_chr %>% filter(Chromatin, t > 0) %>%
    arrange(desc(abs(t))) %>% slice_head(n = CHROM_VOLCANO_LABELS) %>% pull(Gene)
  lab_down <- DE_chr %>% filter(Chromatin, t < 0) %>%
    arrange(desc(abs(t))) %>% slice_head(n = CHROM_VOLCANO_LABELS) %>% pull(Gene)

  DE_chr <- DE_chr %>%
    mutate(Label = ifelse(Gene %in% c(lab_up, lab_down), Gene, NA_character_)) %>%
    arrange(desc(Group == "Other genes"))     # draw background genes first

  p_vol_chr <- ggplot(DE_chr, aes(logFC, minusLog10FDR, color = Group)) +
    geom_point(aes(size = Chromatin, alpha = Chromatin)) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = c(-LOGFC_CUTOFF, LOGFC_CUTOFF),
               linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.4) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(FDR_CUTOFF),
               linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.4) +
    geom_text_repel(aes(label = Label), size = 3.2, max.overlaps = Inf,
                    box.padding = 0.4, min.segment.length = 0,
                    segment.size = 0.3, show.legend = FALSE, color = "black") +
    scale_color_manual(
      values = c("Chromatin gene, higher in Grade 3"   = COL_G3,
                 "Chromatin gene, higher in Grade 1/2" = COL_G12,
                 "Other genes"                          = COL_NS),
      name = NULL) +
    scale_size_manual(values = c("TRUE" = 2, "FALSE" = 1), guide = "none") +
    scale_alpha_manual(values = c("TRUE" = 0.9, "FALSE" = 0.4), guide = "none") +
    labs(title = "Chromatin pathway leading-edge genes",
         subtitle = paste0("Genes in the leading edge of significant chromatin pathways (n = ",
                           length(le_genes), "); dashed lines: FDR ", FDR_CUTOFF,
                           " and |logFC| = ", LOGFC_CUTOFF),
         x = expression(log[2]~"fold change (Grade 3 \u2212 Grade 1/2)"),
         y = expression(-log[10]~"(FDR)")) +
    theme_pub(14) +
    theme(legend.position = "top")

  save_fig(p_vol_chr, file.path(chrom_dir, "Chromatin_leading_edge_volcano"), 8.5, 7.5)

  write.csv(
    DE_chr %>% filter(Chromatin) %>%
      dplyr::select(Gene, logFC, t, P.Value, adj.P.Val, Group) %>%
      arrange(Group, desc(abs(t))),
    file.path(chrom_dir, "Chromatin_leading_edge_gene_DE.csv"), row.names = FALSE
  )

} else {
  message("No significant chromatin pathways in Part A: Part C skipped.")
}

cat("\nChromatin analysis complete. Output:", chrom_dir, "\n")
```
